failure_summary.description: The agent skipped a requested search or update, used an unsuitable cached result, or omitted required result persistence.
The agent repeated an already-applied criterion, misread a usable location, or dropped a preference supplied in a follow-up answer.
The agent imported tools from a nonexistent module instead of calling injected functions directly.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers cache updates, saving results, location mapping, and direct tool calls, so repeating those rules would not address a documented gap. The clearest additional gap is reliably binding a follow-up answer to the field asked about and retaining every supported criterion when the answer combines preferences.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Treat answers to the immediately preceding domain-specific follow-up as explicit values for the field(s) asked about, including brief agreements that add details or replies combining multiple preferences. Carry forward every distinct supported criterion in the answer, not only its final clause; when updating results, apply each criterion not already represented in the selected compatible cached result.
